description: Issue #867 (PR #884 cross-vendor review fix): neutralizes RequestBindingPolicy.Classify's static-member guard (`if (IsStaticMember(member)) return BindingRejectionReason.StaticMember;`, src/WalkingTec.Mvvm.Core/Helper/RequestBindingPolicy.cs) with a compile-preserving `&& false` (not a deletion). Issue #1080 moved this guard's walk out of IsPathAllowed and into Classify (which returns a BindingRejectionReason instead of bool); IsPathAllowed(Type, string, string)/IsPathAllowed(object, string, string) are now pure delegations (`Classify(...) == BindingRejectionReason.None`), so this mutant still turns IsPathAllowed's own assertion red -- see the 'With the guard neutralized' sentence below. The gateway-TYPE guard on the following line stays intact -- which matters, because the ONE real static member on the production graph (WTMContext.ReloadUserFunc) is only reachable via 'Wtm', whose resolved type (WTMContext) the gateway-TYPE guard ALSO independently rejects; an HTTP-level test posting 'Wtm.ReloadUserFunc' would therefore stay green under this mutant for the wrong reason (caught by the untouched gateway guard, not proving anything about the static guard specifically) -- see this issue's own exhaustive-table analysis, section 4 point 2. This mutant is instead checked directly against RequestBindingPolicyTests867.IsPathAllowed_PublicStaticField_ReturnsFalse, which targets FixtureVM.StaticSecret -- a public static field that does not resolve to any BannedGatewayTypes entry and is declared on a type that is not BaseVM/BaseSearcher/WTMContext -- specifically isolating the static-member guard from the gateway-type guard. With the guard neutralized, Classify(vm, "StaticSecret") returns BindingRejectionReason.None instead of StaticMember; because IsPathAllowed is a pure delegation to Classify, IsPathAllowed(vm, "StaticSecret") also returns true instead of false, which is what turns the assertion red. The green control, IsPathAllowed_SearcherDotCustomFilterField_ReturnsTrue, exercises a legitimate non-static Searcher.ZipCode path and is genuinely unaffected by this mutant.
target_symbol: RequestBindingPolicy.Classify(Type, string, string) -- the `if (IsStaticMember(member)) return BindingRejectionReason.StaticMember;` guard condition (IsPathAllowed is now a pure delegation to Classify, per Issue #1080)

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Core.Test.Helper.Request: must be rejected independently of the gateway-type check

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Re-captured verbatim (issue #1080 refactor: patch retargeted from IsPathAllowed to Classify) against a clean checkout with the regenerated mutant patch applied (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first): 'Assert.IsFalse failed. #867: Type.GetMember defaults to Public|Instance|Static, so a public static field is reachable through an instance path and must be rejected independently of the gateway-type check.'. Confirmed via python3 test/mutants/run_mutant.py --mutant wtmsec867-static-member-guard-neutralize: 'VERDICT: KILLED' / 'GATE: PASS'.
